Phase 1 gave measure.mjs a per-scenario focusTarget (this scenario: [data-qa=otp0]) so focus is now captured instead of blurred away; otp1..otp5 are left blurred and keep their idle border. borderColor is NOT asserted on this box: the focused stroke is 2 CSS px of #009577 under a 1.5x JPEG, which samples #1e7d69 / #158366 (30 off the real value) — the same under-sampled-stroke category that got the --field-border token rejected, so the STATE is asserted (focused:true, borderWidth 2) and the colour is not. OtpInput autofocuses box 0 by app behaviour (refs.current[digits.length].focus()).
